Build Maia City's intent {intent} on play ("{title}") in avenBOX, the cloud environment our agents prototype in (Postgres up, TEST_DATABASE_URL set: play/avenbox/up.sh). Read it and its approved spec with the maia-play MCP tool get_intent. Build what its goal and scope say. Run every check and record it with bun play/avenbox/intent.ts {intent} --record (it runs each check's run and records it with check_intent, a failure as a failure; record a look by hand with check_intent); repeat until every must check passes: then the intent moves to Proposal by itself, where an admin decides it. If the work is play's (an asset or story version, a sandbox change, a factory or a config), propose it with the propose tool's intent: "{intent}" (it puts this intent at Proposal with the work); play refuses it before every must check passes. If the work is code, open a pull request into main with the line Intent: {intent} at the end of its commits' messages, and record the checks on its head with bun play/avenbox/intent.ts {intent} --record --pr <its number>; then stop: never merge it, into main or production. An admin's Accept here merges it and ships it to production, followed live in Ship.
